# Ed Chapman — edwardchapman.co.uk

> Personal site of Ed Chapman, a senior software engineer in London: backend
> and platform depth in Python/Django, product engineering in TypeScript and
> React, infrastructure on AWS/Terraform, and AI-native delivery with
> evaluation discipline (eval harnesses in CI, grounded generation with
> citations).

This file is a discovery aid, not a security boundary. It is maintained by
hand alongside content changes (process: docs/development.md in the site
repository) until the site's build generates it from published content.

## Pages

- [Home](https://edwardchapman.co.uk/): positioning, selected projects,
  how I work, technical focus, contact
- [Projects](https://edwardchapman.co.uk/projects): case studies with
  architecture, decisions, limitations, and next steps —
  [Foreman](https://edwardchapman.co.uk/projects/foreman),
  [AI Due-Diligence Assistant](https://edwardchapman.co.uk/projects/ai-due-diligence-assistant),
  [claude-code-config](https://edwardchapman.co.uk/projects/claude-code-config)
- [Notes](https://edwardchapman.co.uk/notes): technical writing — first note:
  [LLM-as-judge as a CI quality gate](https://edwardchapman.co.uk/notes/llm-as-judge-as-a-ci-quality-gate)
- [Ask](https://edwardchapman.co.uk/ask): ask questions about Ed's published
  work and get grounded, cited answers — refuses when the site doesn't cover it
- [Colophon](https://edwardchapman.co.uk/colophon): how this site is built —
  Astro on Cloudflare Workers, static-first, spec-driven, gated by CI
- [Privacy](https://edwardchapman.co.uk/privacy): no analytics, no cookies,
  no tracking

## Projects

- [Foreman](https://github.com/edjchapman/Foreman): event-driven job pipeline
  (Django, Celery, PostgreSQL, Redis, React) — transactional outbox,
  exactly-once workers, retries with dead-letter redrive, live WebSocket
  progress; load-tested. Demo: https://foreman-demo.up.railway.app
- [AI Due-Diligence Assistant](https://github.com/edjchapman/AI-Due-Diligence-Assistant):
  cited due-diligence reports from a stateful LangGraph.js agent over
  PostgreSQL/pgvector retrieval, with an LLM-as-judge eval harness in CI and
  a keyless demo mode. Demo: https://app-production-e60e.up.railway.app
- [claude-code-config](https://github.com/edjchapman/claude-code-config):
  composable Claude Code agents, skills, and permission templates that
  propagate across projects and machines, validated by CI.

## Source

- [This site's repository](https://github.com/edjchapman/edwardchapman.co.uk):
  commissioning spec, architecture decision records, quality gates, and
  deployment pipeline — all public.
